status: Proposed production recipes. Only the AV editing subset has an executable adapter in this PR.

recipes.title: Original character dialogue
inputs: voice identity brief or authorised clean reference
stages: Design/audition identity and store accepted dry reference
Generate bounded per-line takes with pronunciation and delivery controls
Transcribe independently, compare intended text and review performance
Align accepted transcript, derive captions and mouth cues
Place dry takes in timeline, layer treatment and render

recipes.title: Localization and dubbing
stages: Translate with character and context notes; preserve line IDs
Record pronunciation lexicon and bounded timing targets
Generate and review target-language takes
Align captions; correct overshoot by performance/script before extreme stretch
Export language variants and source mappings
acceptance: no forced alignment passed off as ASR accuracy

recipes.title: Adaptive game music
stages: Choose exact ACE-Step variant for requested task
Audition short original phrase and accept harmonic/tempo identity
Create low/high intensity and intro/loop/outro derivatives
Edit stems or native tracks in DAW; inspect phase and boundary
Export event/state mappings and test transitions in engine
acceptance: no claimed lossless stems from separated mix

recipes.title: Scene-aligned Foley
stages: Derive intended contacts from scene and label each cue
Compare sample/procedural baseline with a generated candidate
Separate attack body and tail where useful
Align and layer cues with explicit gain and room treatment
Review image/sound contact and export dry/mixed variants

recipes.title: Audio cleanup and isolation
stages: Preserve untouched source and rights record
Separate target or denoise conservatively
A/B compare timbre and residual leakage
Apply explicit effect chain and measured output QC

recipes.title: Editable sung performance
stages: Prepare score/lyrics with syllable alignment
Generate singing with recorded pitch/delivery controls
Edit phonemes and pitch in native singing project
Export dry vocal and DAW arrangement

recipes.title: Anime avatar acting and dialogue
stages: Inspect bones expressions materials and format versions
Approve pose/appearance and render neutral reference
Retarget motion then correct contacts/root/costume
Generate accepted dialogue separately and map cues to actual expressions
Render shot and finish mix/captions in timeline
acceptance: engine export distinct from animation rig

recipes.title: Download and animate a creator-issued game rig
stages: Fetch authorised tier and record archive hashes/credits
Inspect actual mesh/skeleton/clip contents
Compare idle/walk and explicit root-motion mapping
Render contact/stress tests and preserve source
Export and test actual engine controller
acceptance: free subset not confused with full library

recipes.title: Non-destructive audiovisual edit
stages: Validate source ranges and frame/sample clock
Propose edits against expected project revision
Render bounded preview and inspect decoded frames/audio samples
Keep native source and unsupported-interchange report
Render accepted range or version
